commits.message: final-v1's intent, rebased onto the sleeved list: 7 spell swaps and the 4 fetchlands not already in paper
Hallowed Fountain for a Forest: an Island-typed target for the blue fetches
Irrigated Farmland and Cascade Bluffs for the two remaining at-target lands
Mana tightening: two Triomes and a true dual for a basic, a slow black dual and a tapped tribal land
Keep Hellkite Courser: it IS a Dragon, and it deploys the commander untaxed
Re-balance the land pass: blue is over target once Marang is gone, red is not
Breeding Pool for a Mountain: the last surplus blue source becomes red

staged.why: final-v1's one authored swap: a single-job tutor for a protection enchantment; Sarkhan's Triumph stays as the instant-speed Dragon tutor.
Eight mana for a token engine that needs to connect first, for a UU Dragon two mana cheaper.
An anthem that needs a wide board this deck does not build, for a Dragon with a second mode.

Return grants NO TRAMPLE and is stopped by a single chump block, which the Golgari finisher research confirmed independently; its real job was the draw mode. Steel Hellkite is a colourless body with a repeatable board answer.
Six mana to draw off a creature that has to survive, for three mana of instant-speed indestructible and a free equip that protects the commander.
A red planeswalker whose loyalty needs defending, for a one-mana counter that is Force Spike until a Dragon lands and then answers a wrath.
The mana pass: a painland for a fetch.
The mana pass: a conditional-untapped dual for a fetch.
The mana pass: a conditional-untapped dual for a fetch.
The mana pass: the last of the four fetches final-v1 wanted that is not already sleeved.

Green reads +4 OVER its Karsten target while blue is short by 13, and mana-fit names Forest as a cut candidate for making only colours already at target. Hallowed Fountain is ISLAND-TYPED, so all three blue fetches in the branch can find it — the deck had only three blue-typed lands total for them to fetch. Owned.

mana-fit names Canopy Vista a cut candidate: GW, and both colours now read at or over target while blue is short 11. Irrigated Farmland is the second ISLAND-TYPED land the blue fetches can find, and it cycles when it is the wrong half. Owned. It enters tapped, which is the cost.

The last Plains makes only a colour at target. Cascade Bluffs filters into UU or RR, which is exactly the two costs this branch adds — Marang River Regent and Transcendent Dragon are both {4}{U}{U}. Owned. It needs another land first, which is the cost.

TIGHTENING. Ketria carries THREE basic types (Forest Island Mountain), so every fetch in the deck can find it, and it makes G, U and R — the two colours this list is short of plus the one it is built on. Green reads OVER target and mana-fit named Forest a cut candidate for making only colours already at target. Cost: it enters tapped.

TIGHTENING. Smoldering Marsh is a slow B/R dual, and black is TWO CARDS in the 99 — the commander's single pip and Crux of Fate. Raugrin (Island Mountain Plains) makes U, R and W, all three of which are short, and its three basic types make it a fetch target for the whole manabase.

TIGHTENING. Path enters tapped and its filter is Dragon-gated, so it does nothing for Stubborn Denial or any noncreature spell. Volcanic Island is an untapped U/R dual, Island-typed for the fetches, and U and R are the deck's two shortest real colours.

RE-BALANCE after keeping Hellkite Courser. Dropping Marang River Regent removed the second {4}{U}{U} card, which collapsed blue's Karsten target from 36 sources to 22 — blue now reads +7 OVER target on 29 sources, while RED, at 54.5% of the deck's pips, is 5 short. Irrigated Farmland is the weakest land in the branch on two counts: it makes only W and U, the colours that no longer need help, and it was the worst performer in the 177-game Forge run at 8 discards against 5 activations because it enters tapped. Taiga is a Mountain Forest true dual, always untapped, two basic types so every relevant fetch finds it, and it is red.

Same re-balance. Hallowed Fountain is the other pure W/U land, and blue is over target while red is short. Plateau is a Mountain Plains true dual — untapped, no life paid, two basic types — so it replaces the white source being cut AND adds the red one the deck needs.

The last re-balance. mana-fit names Breeding Pool a cut candidate: it makes G and U, and with Marang gone blue sits +5 OVER target while green is +2. RED is the only real colour still short at -3, on 54.5% of the deck's pips. A Mountain is a red source that is always untapped, never dead, and is itself a fetch target for four of the eight fetches. Breeding Pool's Forest Island types are a fetch target too, but for the two colours that no longer need one.

proposal.why: final-v1's decision, applied to the list the pilot actually has sleeved. Authored 2026-09-11 off prescription 0241fb6a70f1 — five games at 1W 4L, 'speed without protection or politics makes me the obvious kill target before I can close'. All eleven of final-v1's real changes carried unaltered; the six entries that read as changes only because the 2026-09-17 scan moved the deck underneath it are dropped. Plus the mana tightening: two Triomes and a Volcanic Island. Crux of Fate stays and the black splash is bought deliberately.

proposal.forced_reason: The objective is mine and it was the wrong one. I set interaction_6 >= 0.60 when I opened this branch on 2026-09-17 for a reading of it that no longer holds — that its case was protection density. It reads 0.570, a miss of 0.030 against an MDE of 0.022, so it is a real miss of a badly chosen measure. What the branch actually does is trade two fat red Dragons for two answers and tighten five colours of mana, and interaction_6 counts whether interaction is AFFORDABLE at turn six rather than whether the deck holds any. The rows that moved are the ones to read: board power @t6 +0.48, killed by t6 27 -> 30 per 100, killed by t10 95 -> 96, three better and NONE WORSE — damage @t10 fell back inside the noise band once the manabase was tightened, having read WORSE before it. The deterministic half is the stronger case: mana-fit takes blue from 9 short to 7, red from 6 to 5, and now returns no cut candidates at all. Forge against standard-v3 is the arbiter and has not been run on this list; the 177-game run was on an earlier commit of this branch and could not even load two of its cards.
